messages.text:
The ZIP fixtures include AES-encrypted entries (`compress_type 99`), so using Python’s `zipfile` alone would miss the main behavior.

I’m implementing the real AES password-verification path from ZIP metadata plus ZipCrypto fallback, and keeping the verifier outside runtime so the program does not depend on oracle artifacts.
